CustomObject.description: Handoff from the guest endpoint to the processor. Its only job is to change the running user: a platform event subscriber trigger executes as the Automated Process user, whereas a Queueable or a future method enqueued from the guest transaction would still run as the guest. Carries only the Webhook_Event__c id - the payload stays on that row, which keeps the event small and the durable record single.
CustomObject.label: Webhook Event Received
